summary: OS Therapies Inc filed an 8-K regarding entry into a securities purchase agreement with Leonite Fund I, LP for a private placement of a senior secured convertible promissory note up to $10,000,000, with an initial tranche of $1,600,000 funded July 2, 2026, plus 275,000 commitment shares and a warrant for 1,750,000 shares. The filing also notes departure of directors/officers, compensatory arrangements, and creation of a direct financial obligation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, or other special situation is present. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special-situation event.
